facts.fact: IFC (the World Bank Group's private-sector lender, not a Comorian body) agreed in June 2025 to lend EUR 25 million to Yas Comoros, an AXIAN Telecom subsidiary, for 5G, FTTH, FTTO and inter-island connectivity.
facts.system: IFC EUR 25m loan to Yas Comoros

facts.fact: IFC lent EUR 13 million to Yas Comoros in 2019 for its initial network rollout after it won the second telecom licence; the document says the loan was fully repaid in June 2025.
facts.system: IFC EUR 13m loan to Yas Comoros (2019)
